scope: Adopted hidden judging inputs reconstructed from the official graph archive with fixed structure-preserving relabeling. Public development inputs retain their independent recipe and byte identity.

transform.seed_derivation: First eight SHA-256 bytes of seed_tag + colon + original output basename, interpreted as an unsigned big-endian integer. The stable seed tag retains its original algorithm bytes.
transform.ordering: Shuffle vertex labels once, then shuffle each mapped adjacency list in old-vertex order; emit adjacency rows in new-vertex order, preserving empty rows and duplicate edges.

reference_binding: Every adopted reference key and B/K value is preserved. Vertex relabeling preserves the directed feedback-vertex-set optimum. Raw official graphs are not the judging payload.
terms: No explicit redistribution license was provided with the official graph archive. Local reconstruction does not grant additional redistribution rights.
